name: preallow
description: Lets Claude Code auto mode run the steps of the task you gave without the classifier: a model judge allows what is reversible or what you explicitly asked for

model.title: Judge model
model.description: The model the judge runs on, passed to the model client as you write it: an alias or a full model id. Leave empty for the plugin's default.

effort.title: Judge effort
effort.description: How hard the judge thinks, passed to the model client as you write it. Leave empty for the plugin's default.
